verdict.rationale: Supermemory is API-first. Its docs show API coverage for ingestion, search, memory creation, document list/get/update/delete, container-scoped deletion, and branding settings via a settings endpoint, with official TypeScript and Python clients. Nothing explicitly claims or maps parity with the console or consumer app, and no OpenAPI spec was found at the probed paths. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, documented API control of connector setup and other console workflows, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
